map.标杆分析用于量化自身与行业/内部标杆的差距，明确改进优先级：: Benchmarking analysis quantifies the gap between your own performance and industry or internal benchmarks to set improvement priorities:
map.相对差距 rel =（标杆值 − 自身值）÷ 标杆值；方向为 low（越低越好，: Relative gap rel = (benchmark value − own value) ÷ benchmark value; when the direction is low (lower is better, such as expense ratio or vacancy rate) the sign is inverted, so "better than benchmark" is negative and "behind" is positive.
map.综合差距评分 = 各项 |rel| 的均值 ×100%；按 |rel| 降序取: Composite gap score = mean of the |rel| values × 100%; sorting by |rel| descending takes the Top3 as priority improvement items.

map.标杆项目怎么选？: How should benchmark projects be chosen?
map.选同城市、同档次、规模相近且公开数据可信的项目，避免跨类型硬比导致结论失真。: Pick projects in the same city and tier with similar scale and credible public data, avoiding cross-category comparisons that distort the conclusion.
map.对标后只抄指标行吗？: Is copying only the metrics enough after benchmarking?
map.不行，要分析标杆背后的流程（排班、培训、回访），把做法本地化，而非只追数字。: No. Analyse the processes behind the benchmark (rostering, training, follow-up) and localise the practice rather than chasing numbers alone.
